title: What to Wear to Work This Fall: 2026 Style Guide
summary: Getting dressed for work just got easier. Our Stylists rounded up the fall building blocks that mix and match effortlessly—tailored trousers, crisp Oxfords and knit dresses—so you never have to overthink an outfit at 7 a.m. See the formulas.
body_markdown:
When the seasons shift, so does your work wardrobe. Fall is a natural reset moment, making it the perfect time to refresh your 9-to-5 style. Whether you’re heading into a corporate office, logging into Zoom from a café or working somewhere in between, Stitch Fix Stylists are here to help solve the what to wear to work dilemma.


This season is all about intentional building blocks—polished, versatile pieces that mix and match, so you never have to overthink an outfit at 7 a.m. And a[fall wardrobe](https://www.stitchfix.com/women/blog/style-guide/5-office-ready-fall-essentials-to-promote-in-your-wardrobe/) you love doesn’t have to break the bank, with tops from $29 and sweaters and denim from $49. We asked our expert Stylists to share the tailored staples and easy office formulas that take the guesswork out of getting dressed—so[schedule your Fix today](https://www.stitchfix.com/signup) .


## **Fall Workwear Essentials: Building Blocks & Office Formulas**


Every effortless work outfit starts with a few reliable pieces you can mix and match. These are the four fall building blocks our Stylists recommend, each one a foundation you can dress up or down.


### **Tailored Trousers: The Foundation of Any Work Outfit**


Bottoms set the tone for the whole fit, and this fall it starts with a clean, tailored trouser. Wide-leg and straight silhouettes instantly create a streamlined shape that looks flattering on every[body type](https://www.stitchfix.com/women/blog/style-guide/find-fit-for-your-body-type/) —you really can’t go wrong with this cut at work. The formula is simple: pair tailored trousers with structured classics like a crisp button-down or a fitted knit for a look that feels effortless but intentional.


### **The Oxford Shirt: A Timeless Workwear Staple**


A crisp Oxford shirt is the workwear staple that does it all. The best part? It pairs effortlessly with the rest of your building blocks—tuck it into tailored trousers or a structured skirt, or layer it under a cardigan to navigate any hybrid schedule. The same shirt carries you from a morning meeting to whatever the afternoon throws your way.


> “Relaxed trousers and a crisp Oxford are an easy way to modernize classic workwear. Try a partial tuck or roll the sleeves for a more effortless feel, then add a loafer or Mary Jane to keep the look polished without feeling overly corporate.”
> —Caro, Stylist


### **How to Style a Cardigan as a Work Top**


It’s time to reframe the cardigan. It’s not just a layer you throw on when the office AC kicks in—it’s a statement piece in its own right. A sleek, buttoned-up cardigan worn on its own reads polished and deliberate, and it styles directly with trousers or a skirt for a balanced, accessible office look. Think of it as the softer, easier alternative to a structured top, with all the cozy comfort fall calls for.


> “Give your fall workwear a fresh update by styling a cardigan as a top—button it up and pair it with tailored trousers or a polished skirt. It’s an easy way to make cozy layers feel intentional and office-ready.”
> —Jackie, Stylist


### **Polished Knit Dresses for Desk-to-Dinner Style**


If there’s one piece every work wardrobe needs,[it’s a go-to dress](https://www.stitchfix.com/women/blog/style-guide/find-the-perfect-dress/) that makes you feel polished with minimal effort. For fall 2026, structured knit dresses are taking center stage—think sheath silhouettes and a tailored look that creates a sleek, professional shape without feeling restrictive.


Look for midweight fabrics with a touch of stretch for all-day comfort, and a length that hits at the knee or below. Best of all, they flow seamlessly from back-to-back meetings to dinner without a single change.


## **Fall 2026 Color Trends & Work Accessories**


The right palette and finishing pieces are what pull a work look together. This season it’s all about rich autumn tones and a few standout accessories that do the heavy lifting.


### **The Power Palette: Wine, Espresso + a Touch of Butter**


Lean into the must-have shades of wine red and espresso brown, accented by soft touches of butter yellow. These rich autumn tones are made for monochromatic outfitting—head-to-toe in one shade family reads instantly elevated and exudes corporate confidence with little effort.


> “Treat wine red and espresso brown as your new fall neutrals. They pair beautifully with each other and with wardrobe staples like cream, navy and denim. Add a touch of butter yellow when you want to brighten the palette without losing that polished fall feel.”
> —Caro, Stylist


### **Work Accessories: The Finishing Touch**


The right finishing pieces anchor the whole office uniform, and this fall it comes down to a structural bag and sophisticated shoes.


- **The East West Bag:** A structural, elongated standout that updates traditional proportions and instantly elevates a work fit. Its horizontal shape is the fresh, of-the-moment update to a classic tote.
- **Mary Janes & Loafers:** The definitive workwear footwear completers—polished, comfortable and season-proof.


> “Mary Jane flats bring a polished, feminine touch to fall workwear while still feeling comfortable and modern. Pair them with tailored trousers, midi skirts, or a great pair of jeans for an easy update to your everyday office style.”
> —Jackie, Stylist
